# Hindi PDF Editor — Full Documentation & AI Grounding Reference

> **Website:** https://hindipdfeditor.com  
> **Primary Web Application:** https://hindipdfeditor.com/  
> **Android Companion App:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hindipdfeditor.app  
> **Contact / Support:** support@hindipdfeditor.com  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose

Hindi PDF Editor is a free web and Android application for working with Hindi (Devanagari) PDFs. Its focus is adding and replacing Hindi text without the scattered matras and broken conjuncts that users often run into when general-purpose PDF editors change Hindi text.

Tools:
1. **Edit Hindi PDF**: Replace detected Hindi or English lines, add new text boxes, or erase text on the page.
2. **Translate Hindi ↔ English**: Translate detected text in either direction and place it back on the page.
3. **Merge and Split**: Combine PDFs in the order selected, or extract a page range.
4. **Compress**: Re-encode pages as JPEG with a quality slider to shrink scanned PDFs.
5. **Text recognition (OCR)**: Read printed Hindi and English on scanned pages, in the browser or, if the user confirms, with AI text recognition.

---

## 2. How the Editor Handles Devanagari

PDF stores positioned glyphs, not editable text. Devanagari needs a shaping engine to turn a sequence like क + ् + ष into the conjunct क्ष, or to place the matra in कि before its consonant. When a tool edits existing Hindi text without that shaping step, matras detach and conjuncts split.

Hindi PDF Editor does not edit the PDF's glyphs. Instead:

- Each page is rendered as a high-resolution background image.
- New and replacement text is laid out as HTML, so the browser's own shaping engine (the one that renders Hindi web pages) produces the conjuncts and matras, using the Noto Sans Devanagari font.
- On the web, each composed page is exported as a high-resolution image inside a new PDF. The Hindi looks the same on every device, but the exported text is not selectable or searchable.

---

## 3. Privacy and Data Handling

- **In the browser**: Opening, rendering, editing, merging, splitting and compressing run on the user's device. The PDF file is not uploaded.
- **Optional AI features**: Translation sends the detected text lines, and AI text recognition sends page images, to a server-side Gemini proxy. Both run only after the user confirms and passes a security check. No API key is requested from the user.
- **Original files**: The source PDF is never modified; every export is a new file.
- **Appropriate use**: The tool is for documents the user may change — blank forms, affidavits, applications and their own drafts. Documents issued by an authority, such as admit cards, mark sheets or land records, should be corrected through the issuing office, not edited.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Ground Truth)

### Q: What is Hindi PDF Editor?
**A:** A free web and Android tool to add and replace Hindi (Devanagari) text in PDFs without broken matras, translate Hindi ↔ English, and merge, split or compress PDFs. Editing runs in the browser without uploading the file.

### Q: How do I edit Hindi text in a PDF online?
**A:**
1. Open https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit-hindi-pdf/ (Hindi: https://hindipdfeditor.com/hi/edit-hindi-pdf/).
2. Select your PDF.
3. Tap a detected line to replace it, or tap a blank area to add text.
4. Type in Unicode Hindi with any Hindi keyboard or Google Input Tools.
5. Export to download a new PDF. The original file is unchanged.

### Q: Why do Hindi matras break when editing in other PDF editors?
**A:** Many editors change existing Hindi text without running it through a shaping engine, so matras land in the wrong place and conjuncts split. Hindi PDF Editor has the browser shape every new line of Hindi text.

### Q: Can it convert Kruti Dev PDFs to Unicode?
**A:** No. It detects Kruti Dev and other legacy fonts and warns the user. The user can then cover old text and add new text in a Unicode font. The existing legacy text is not converted.

### Q: Is it safe for government documents?
**A:** Editing happens on the device and the file is not uploaded unless the user chooses an AI feature. Use it for forms, affidavits and applications you are allowed to fill in. Do not alter issued documents such as admit cards or land records; corrections to those come from the issuing office.

### Q: Is there any cost?
**A:** No. It is free, with no account, subscription or watermark.
